metadataDescription: Optional organization-level RFxchange Founding Membership after Exchange value.
heading: Help shape the Exchange without buying market legitimacy.
intro: Founding Membership is optional and organization-level. Core Exchange participation remains free. Founding recognition does not confer verification, qualification, endorsement, Resource Provider approval, credibility, or preferred neutral ranking.

cancellationScheduled: Cancellation is scheduled for the end of the current billing period.
